item.title: RAMA: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Routing with Episodic Memory for LEO Satellite Networks
item.description: Low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks present a challenging routing environment due to rapidly changing topology, traffic, and link conditions. item.title: Adaptive Coverage Algorithms for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks in Dynamic Worlds
item.description: This paper extends an existing framework for the coordination of mobile agents in unknown worlds, by considering the possibility of dynamic instability. In the original problem, known as the Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem (POCGAGP) (arXiv:2512.09495), the multi-agent system must establish a communication network which completely covers an initially unknown constrained space. item.title: Statistical Foundations of Reinforcement Learning: A Non-Asymptotic Perspective
item.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) embodies a foundational paradigm for sequential decision-making in the face of uncertainty. The rapid growth of model complexity in emerging applications has significantly amplified the challenges of achieving data-efficient RL, particularly in sample-starved scenarios where data collection may be costly, time-consuming, or even high-stakes. item.title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication

item.description: Autonomous surface vessels operating in urban waterways must coordinate with other vessels in confined spaces while complying with traffic regulations, often without knowing their intentions. item.title: GPU-accelerated Incremental Euclidean Distance Transform for Online Motion Planning of Mobile Robots
item.description: In this letter, we present a volumetric mapping system that effectively calculates Occupancy Grid Maps (OGMs) and Euclidean Distance Transforms (EDTs) with parallel computing. Unlike these mappers for high-precision structural reconstruction, our system incrementally constructs global EDT and outputs high-frequency local distance information for online robot motion planning. item.description: Deploying 6G network slices across administrative domains requires an online decision for each arriving request: which domain hosts each virtual network function, how traffic crosses domain boundaries, and whether the slice is admitted. item.title: HIPC: Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control via Goal-Conditioned Motion Closure
item.description: Recent generative models are widely used to provide whole-body motion for humanoid tracking. item.title: Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning by Coupling Body-Agnostic World Model with Differentiable Ego-Dynamics
item.description: Motion planning in clutter is embodiment-specific: the feasible free space and reachable commands depend on each robot's geometry and dynamics. item.title: From Evaluation to Evolution: Benchmarking Image Editing and Evolving Image Models
item.description: Real-world image editing requires coordinating multiple visual transformations with content preservation and reference constraints, yet aggregate scores can readily obscure unmet local requirements. item.title: Mechanistic Interpretability for End-to-End Self-Driving
item.description: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving models achieve strong planning performance but remain largely opaque, limiting observability and trust.
